statements.status_notes: curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 7a6bd027d0de2b6857472d35da090ef60cc29f19, which removes credentials from CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-94266.html
curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 557a52f21e37a626725a9e708c02af129c3ece1b, which sends Negotiate or NTLM only to an allowed origin. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-94265.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 8b0744af5b1b631da5b938ca31c3f9895ad5a321, which runs Curl_req_done before the connection done event. curl 8.22.0 still returns the connection with Curl_cpool_do_locked, which the cited commit's later pool API does not use. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92392.html
curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit d7546809d5bd548b69ec49fca26565c8f6f0d344, which frees MIME trees iteratively instead of by recursion. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92391.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit c24a69d8cd368de4e25e3540bf0b7b000a31d5a7, which buffers headers before selecting a remote filename so a 103 early hint cannot bypass no-clobber. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92390.html
curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 63dd390fab905a239a97e2700532929343ebc4e9, which checks TFTP direction before acting on a packet. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92389.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commits b85acacec9b38442741bb019bc992e77b5f665d4 and ba8f8a7f27a5c5e19e4ef212b90b35a93559163e, which keeps the caller write callback during an FTP wildcard listing and uses the list parser only while matching. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92388.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 753735af87f5c30cb6f60a70342f8bc4bc5fd5db, which stops the pingpong reader when the server omits the expected response. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92387.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 445aa87e13f91c94bc742f54343a2eac924e1765, which continues loading a cookie jar when one line exceeds the previous length limit. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92386.html
curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit ed131747c1a3dc7f816d26724c44537ac8acba44, which tightens X.509 name parsing. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87866.html
curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 323c184b6bdf5b1988a10c0a61560666e1588149, which matches hashed known_hosts entries by host. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87865.html

Upstream marks curl >= 8.22.0 as not affected (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87864.html). lib/imap.c in 8.22.0 already rejects APPEND when CRLF conversion makes the size unknown, and cherry-pick of 3b547de301342b347fb3c6ea6ae7979070793a66 onto tag curl-8_22_0 is empty.

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 08d50a791b3197a3d0a4fc2f778e243f5501c67e, which caps HSTS max-age so one response cannot erase persisted entries. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87863.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit a1614c3bcf1593eb524b37792124357d97a5429c, which keeps the longer-lived HSTS entry when a shorter duplicate is imported. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87862.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 7c11f1a1bd53e2cd983fe153e45991302d097647, which refuses to reuse a Negotiate connection for a different origin. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87861.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 00271cfcb95b6481a1f91ce0a0dad5d64d2e89a9, which matches schannel automatic client certificates when a connection is reused. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86415.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 2956af6c7451029fb12c12f8166dff211f930d52, which ignores an HTTP 401 from a CONNECT proxy instead of forwarding host credentials. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86414.html

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 43029e2ec37eba2354ced199ccd8898de695858e, which refuses to reuse an NTLM or Negotiate connection after a redirect. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86413.html
curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 6ded3e594455d6f018fab5f2f5d916eb9bc4ef94, which keeps loading a cookie jar after one malformed cookie. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86412.html

Upstream marks curl >= 8.22.0 as not affected; only 8.21.0 is affected (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86411.html). The cited fix 72352daba01ba8072b6c1c0254cb77860ed1ab06 is already in the 8.22.0 sources, and cherry-pick onto tag curl-8_22_0 is empty.

curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 6ae9befb2fb6bdfdb5fc11fdf76bbe519fe1f52c, which sets SCP and SFTP host verification on every transfer when those protocols are compiled in. tests/data/test1679 is not in the 8.22.0 tarball, so that hunk was omitted. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86410.html

Upstream marks curl >= 8.22.0 as not affected (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86409.html). The cited fix c3c70440e8d9938c0bb732595751e8aebc614f24 is already in the 8.22.0 sources: lib/setopt.c clears CURLAUTH_AWS_SIGV4 when CURLOPT_AWS_SIGV4 is NULL, and cherry-pick onto tag curl-8_22_0 is empty.
curl 8.22.0-r1 backports upstream commit 64fb3e7a7b116f690966054f281624152d4a7651, which stops a GnuTLS WebSocket upload from sending extra bytes. Advisory: https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-107928.html

The DHI BusyBox APK backports the upstream ash evalfun() fix as dhi-cve-2026-38755-ash-function-recursion.patch, enforcing a bounded shell-function recursion depth. Source: https://lists.busybox.net/pipermail/busybox/2026-June/092354.html

The DHI BusyBox APK applies Alpine's ash ifsbreakup() backport as dhi-cve-2026-38754-ash-ifsbreakup-bounds.patch, clearing stale IFS state after expansion errors. Source: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/master/main/busybox/0040-ash-fix-out-of-bounds-read-in-ifsbreakup.patch

The DHI BusyBox APK backports the upstream awk_sub() fix as dhi-cve-2026-38753-awk-sub-use-after-free.patch, copying replacement text before regular-expression evaluation can invalidate its backing storage. Source: https://lists.busybox.net/pipermail/busybox/2026-June/092352.html
